import java.util.*;

public class cf111c {
    static int N, M, FULL;
    static int[][][] DP;
    static int[] BITCOUNT;

    static int count1s(int x) {
        return x == 0 ? 0 : 1 + count1s(x & (x - 1));
    }

    static boolean satisfies(int a, int b, int c) {
        int x = FULL & (b | (b << 1) | (b >> 1) | a | c);
        return x == FULL;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = in.nextInt();
        M = in.nextInt();
        if (N < M) {
            int tmp = N;
            N = M;
            M = tmp;
        }

        FULL = (1 << M) - 1;
        DP = new int[N + 1][1 << M][1 << M];
        BITCOUNT = new int[1 << M];

        for (int i = 0; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << M); ++j) {
                Arrays.fill(DP[i][j], 999);
            }
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << M); ++mask) {
            BITCOUNT[mask] = count1s(mask);
            DP[0][0][mask] = 0;
        }

        for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
            for (int stateC = 0; stateC < (1 << M); ++stateC) {
                for (int stateP = 0; stateP < (1 << M); ++stateP) {
                    for (int statePP = 0; statePP < (1 << M); ++statePP) {
                        if (DP[r - 1][statePP][stateP] != 999 && satisfies(statePP, stateP, stateC)) {
                            DP[r][stateP][stateC] = Math.min(DP[r][stateP][stateC], DP[r - 1][statePP][stateP] + BITCOUNT[stateP]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int best = 999;
        for (int state = 0; state < (1 << M); ++state) {
            best = Math.min(best, DP[N][state][0]);
        }

        System.out.println(N * M - best);
    }
}
